name_zh: 阿赫迈德·扎基·亚马尼/石油部长：石油地缘战略与 OPEC 权力架构
name_en: Ahmed Zaki Yamani/Oil Ministers: Oil Geostrategy & OPEC Power Architecture
description_zh: 阿赫迈德·扎基·亚马尼 (1930-2021) 担任沙特石油部长 1962-1986，OPEC 核心架构师。核心战略：1973 年石油禁运作为地缘政治武器，确立"石油换安全"美沙同盟框架；推动 OPEC 从价格接受者转为价格制定者，建立产量配额/官方售价/收入分配机制；倡导"公平价格"平衡产消国利益，避免西方替代能源研发加速。体现 M168 石油地缘战略——资源主权国家通过联合垄断重塑全球能源秩序，以及 M169 后石油转型前瞻（亚马尼早期投资下游炼化/石化/可再生能源）。
description_en: Ahmed Zaki Yamani (1930-2021) served as Saudi Oil Minister 1962-1986, OPEC chief architect. Core strategy: 1973 oil embargo as geopolitical weapon, establishing "oil for security" US-Saudi alliance framework; drove OPEC from price-taker to price-setter, establishing production quotas/official selling prices/revenue allocation mechanisms; advocated "fair price" balancing producer-consumer interests, avoiding accelerated Western alternative energy R&D. Exemplifies M168 Oil Geostrategy—resource sovereign states reshaping global energy order via collective monopoly—and M169 Post-Oil Transition foresight (Yamani early invested in downstream refining/petrochemicals/renewables).
reason_zh: 亚马尼非单纯技术官僚，而是"石油外交大师"：以资源垄断杠杆撬动地缘政治重构。M168 区隔于 M39 鸟笼经济(通用)、M169 后资源转型(后石油)，核心在于"石油即外交货币、OPEC 即地缘联盟、价格即战略工具"。
reason_en: Yamani not mere technocrat but "oil diplomacy master": leveraging resource monopoly to restructure geopolitics. M168 distinct from M39 Birdcage Economy (general) and M169 Post-Resource Transition (post-oil), core: "oil as diplomatic currency, OPEC as geopolitical alliance, price as strategic tool".
steps_zh: OPEC 制度化建设：1960 年巴格达成立→1970s 配额/官方价/收入分配三大支柱确立
1973 禁运地缘杠杆：阿拉伯产油国减产/禁运西方，油价 4 倍，西方经济震荡
"石油换安全"框架：美军保护沙特/海湾安全，沙特维持产能/美元计价/回流国债
下游产业链延伸：投资炼厂/石化/航运/可再生能源，捕获全产业链价值
人才与标准输出：沙特石油大学/阿美培训/技术标准阿拉伯化，区域人才磁场
steps_en: OPEC institutionalization: 1960 Baghdad founding -> 1970s quotas/official prices/revenue allocation three pillars established
1973 embargo geopolitical lever: Arab producers cut/embargo West, oil price 4x, Western economic shock
"Oil for security" framework: US military protects Saudi/Gulf security, Saudi maintains capacity/dollar pricing/Treasury recycling
Downstream value chain extension: invest in refineries/petrochemicals/shipping/renewables, capture full value chain
Talent & standards export: KFUPM/Aramco training/technical standards Arabization, regional talent magnet
expected_zh: 资源主权国家以"垄断定价+地缘杠杆+产业链延伸"三位一体，将地质禀赋转化为战略自主与代际财富，重塑全球能源治理规则。
expected_en: Resource sovereign states achieve strategic autonomy & intergenerational wealth from geological endowment via trinity of "monopoly pricing + geopolitical leverage + value chain extension", reshaping global energy governance rules.
case_zh: 1973 石油危机油价 $3→$12/桶；OPEC 市场份额峰值 55%；亚马尼 1986 年被解职前主导 24 年；阿美公司 1980 年全面国有化。
case_en: 1973 oil crisis price $3->$12/bbl; OPEC market share peak 55%; Yamani led 24 years until 1986 dismissal; Aramco fully nationalized 1980.
cross_cultural_impact: OPEC model for commodity cartels; petrodollar recycling; energy security doctrine
colonial_history: Ottoman/British influence; Aramco US consortium origin
resource_curse_mitigation: OPEC quota discipline; downstream diversification; Yamani personal renewables investment
